dedupe_keys.name: norwegian reference distribution system data sets cineldi and securel

description: These are four related open data sets describing anonymised Norwegian electricity distribution grids for research use. The CINELDI medium voltage reference system is a 22 kV radial grid with 124 nodes, built from a real system supplied by a distribution company, with hourly load series for one year, reliability data and peak-load scenarios. A second set covers two industrial medium and low voltage radials collected with the operator Norgesnett, with hourly smart-meter loads from 45 customers from March 2019 to March 2022. A third describes four 230 V semi-urban and rural low voltage grids in MATPOWER-format tables, and the SecurEL set, updated in September 2026, is a simplified 132/66 kV high voltage grid with hourly load and generation for 2019 to 2022, failure rates, load scenarios and ambient-adjusted line ratings. They were produced by researchers in the FME CINELDI centre, funded by the Research Council of Norway, and the SecurEL project. All are CSV or spreadsheet files on Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the grids are anonymised and simplified, so they are realistic test systems, not maps of real networks. Simulation uses are power flow, reliability and resilience analysis, and operation and planning studies. Related records: the low voltage tables use the MATPOWER format described in model-matpower.
